description: Frozen projection from raw @joint/core graph events (dia.Graph 'all') to the comparable event journal. Each journal entry carries { name, payload: { elementId, effect, ...changedValues } }. `effect` is derived ONLY by this table; `changedValues` keeps the significant new values (position, size, label text, source/target ids) at 1e-6. Anything not matched by the table projects to effect=other and keeps its raw name, so an unprojected event can never silently compare equal to a projected one.
